items.title: Development of IR Absorption Spectroscopy System Using Tapered PCF-Based Supercontinuum Source
items.description: Development of an IR absorption spectroscopy system using a tapered photonic crystal fiber-based supercontinuum source.
items.modalDescription: Development of an IR absorption spectroscopy system using a tapered photonic crystal fiber-based supercontinuum source. The project was led by S. Dass and supported by the Science and Engineering Research Board (SERB), Government of India.
